name: TraceCheck
description: Independent evaluation service for AI agent execution traces. Submit a goal, trace, and outcome to receive a reliability score (0-100), per-dimension sub-scores, detected issues and concrete process-improvement suggestions. Free during test phase, no API key. Designed for agents that want to verify their own work or improve long-horizon reliability. Also available as an MCP server (streamable HTTP) at https://tracecheck.example.com/mcp with tools evaluate_trace and get_trace_schema.

skills.name: Evaluate agent execution trace
skills.description: Score an agent's multi-step execution trace for reliability and return concrete improvement suggestions. Send POST /a2a/message:send with one message part {"data": {"goal": str, "trace": str, "outcome": str, "agent_name": str (optional)}}. trace = chronological steps, one per line, including what each tool returned, errors with their recovery, and a final 'Verified:' line. Returns a Message whose data part is {score, dimensions, issues, suggestions, summary, version}. Loop: run task, evaluate, apply suggestions, re-run, compare.
examples: Evaluate this trace for the goal 'book a flight and confirm the reservation'.
Check if my multi-step research process completed correctly and suggest improvements.

{"goal": "Find the cheapest direct flight AMS->LIS on 12 March and report price and flight number", "trace": "1. Called search_flights(...)\n2. Observed: returned 4 flights...\n3. Verified: matches goal", "outcome": "KL1693, EUR 89"}
